description:
Cold emails are NOT dead — you're just doing them wrong. In this high-energy masterclass, Adam,  Pete, and Andy Mewborn break down the 3-part formula for writing cold emails that actually get replies. Learn why being different (even if worse) outperforms “better but boring,” how pattern interrupts and perspective shifts can radically boost engagement, and why your first two emails should never pitch. 

With real-world examples, this episode exposes the exact system behind generating meetings, scaling demand, and building irresistible outreach — all without sounding like a desperate salesperson. If you're still obsessing over personalization or writing emails that start with “Hope this finds you well,” this episode will change your game.
